WITH filtered_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount 
      WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount 
    END as signed_amount,
    balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE amount >= 2400
    AND type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
),
account_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    AVG(signed_amount) as avg_signed_amount,
    AVG(balance) as avg_balance
  FROM filtered_trans
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_signed_amount),
  AVG(avg_balance)
FROM account_avgs
